name: io.github.Miyamura80/MCP-Template
title: GmailMCP
description: Give your AI agent real tools - one service registry over CLI, MCP, and HTTP.

tools.name: gmail_connect
tools.description: Begin the Google OAuth flow to link a Gmail account

tools.name: gmail_status
tools.description: Return whether the user has a linked Gmail account

tools.name: gmail_disconnect
tools.description: Revoke and remove the user's linked Gmail account

tools.name: gmail_get_draft
tools.description: Fetch a single Gmail draft by id

tools.name: gmail_update_draft
tools.description: Patch fields on an existing Gmail draft and open an interactive composer

tools.name: gmail_compose
tools.description: Create a new Gmail draft and open an interactive composer

tools.name: gmail_discard_draft
tools.description: Delete a Gmail draft by id

tools.name: gmail_reply_to_thread
tools.description: Create a reply draft on an existing Gmail thread

tools.name: gmail_list_inbox
tools.description: List recent inbox messages, optionally filtered by a Gmail search query

tools.name: gmail_get_thread
tools.description: Fetch a Gmail thread by id with full message bodies and attachments

tools.name: gmail_curate_inbox
tools.description: Rank recent inbox threads by a deterministic importance score

tools.name: gmail_mark_thread_read
tools.description: Mark a Gmail thread as read

tools.name: gmail_mark_thread_done
tools.description: Mark a Gmail thread as done (hides it from the curated inbox)

tools.name: gmail_unmark_thread_done
tools.description: Remove the done label from a thread (undo mark-done)
